taiwan_towns.provider: Taiwan Ministry of the Interior, National Land Surveying and Mapping Center (NLSC)

taiwan_towns.source_crs: EPSG:3824 (TWD97 geographic / TWD97[2020] label in supplied PRJ)
taiwan_towns.transform: Null geographic datum transformation from TWD97 to WGS84; no coordinate epoch transformation; approximately metre-level datum accuracy. Not cadastral/survey data.
taiwan_towns.simplification: Douglas-Peucker tolerance 0.00002 degrees (about 2.2 m latitude); rounded to 6 decimals
taiwan_towns.patch: Official Town_Majia_Sanhe.shp replaces main TOWNCODE 10013280 (includes Sanhe detached area).
taiwan_towns.storage: Lossless gzip; sha256 refers to decompressed original GeoJSON bytes.
